_doc: Point-in-time fact sheet for FANG (Diamondback Energy, Inc., CIK 1539838), generated by retro/generators/fang/gen_fang.py from the filings; every value is tied to a source and becomes visible only on or after its 'published' date (EDGAR's acceptance time in ET: accepted at or after 16:00, the next trading day). It holds what decides whether a date can be built under method r2, and nothing else: each offering document's and 10-K's annual history, the FY2012 first-day tax charge, the listing record, the no-dividend statement and the price basis. No share of Diamondback traded before 2012-10-12; the predecessors were limited liability companies with no shares, and no filing to 2013-12-31 prints a GAAP earnings per share for any full year (2012's only per-share figure is pro forma), so no date of 2008-2013 has a full year of the company's own EPS to anchor a P/E and none is built (retro/README.md, "FANG 2008-2009"). No print, guide, signal or theme event is transcribed, and the builder refuses any date that passes the gate until they are. | 2014-2017: extended by retro/generators/fang/gen_fang_1417.py with the FY2013-FY2016 10-K vintages (gate periods and model fields), the prints Q3 2013-Q3 2017 with each Q4 release's year and its one-off test, and the rule-T values; FY2013 is the first full year of Diamondback's own EPS (retro/README.md, "FANG 2014-2017").
price_basis: Yahoo's FANG series is Diamondback Energy, Inc.'s common stock (NASDAQ: FANG) from its first point, 2012-10-12 (firstTradeDate), the first trading day the FY2012 10-K states; Yahoo's series records no split. No share of the issuer or its predecessors traded before it (the predecessors were limited liability companies controlled by Wexford Capital LP).

rule_t._doc: Rule T over the annual changes the filings public on 2014-02-21 (the first built date) report, each from the latest filing that reports both years: the FY2013 10-K (Item 2's production and price history for 2011-2013, Item 6 for 2009-2013) and the FY2012 10-K (2010's production and unit cost, 2008's revenue and income before income taxes); the Predecessors' years as the 10-Ks present them (combined under common control). Lease operating expense per BOE is on each 10-K's own basis (the FY2013 10-K moves ad valorem taxes out of it and corporate overhead into it).
